title: Chapter 137 It'S Time To Go Back
content:
Chapter 137 It'S Time To Go Back

Immediately, Lu Daosheng told Wan Feng what he thought.

A long time later, in Wan Feng's shocked gaze, he took the ring handed over by Lu Daosheng.

Looking at the ring in his hand, Wanfeng suddenly became short of breath.

This is a bit too much.

"Master, you,"

Lu Daosheng shook his head.

"Just go and do it."

Lu Daosheng still trusts Wan Feng very much now, after all, this is her wife's disciple.

As far as he knows, he is also the only one.

Besides, Anhui Feng has great potential, and the power of taboo is not a common power.

Looking at Lu Daosheng's trusting gaze, Wan Feng was moved, and then nodded firmly and said, "Don't worry, Master, I won't let you down."

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly.

“Just do your best.”

"Also, don't be afraid of anything. Behind you are me and Lingyun."

.........

The lower realm, reaching the divine star field.

God is inward.

"Your Majesty, the deserted city is developing very fast, and now it has seriously threatened us."

In the hall, an old man frowned. He was shocked and afraid of the deserted city.

A force that emerged from a remote star domain can actually develop to a point where it can almost match their Divine Dynasty in a short period of time.

It's terrible to think about it carefully.

Hearing this, the other powerful people from the Divine Dynasty frowned, and then looked at Yan Lingyun, who had a cold look above.

Although Your Majesty said that you don’t need to pay attention to the wasteland city for the time being, if you really don’t care, the current development speed of the wasteland city is really a bit terrifying.

"I have said that the deserted city is not our enemy."

Faced with the worries of the ministers, Yan Lingyun just responded lightly.

As soon as these words came out, the people in the court suddenly became silent.

Her Majesty the Empress has already said this, so they naturally dare not talk about this matter again.

And they also discovered something that His Majesty seemed to care about the deserted city.

At the same time, Wang Zhen and several of his confidants rushed back to the Shen Dynasty.

Ao Qing also followed him.

Yan Lingyun also praised Wang Zhen for leading his army to take over the Tianlin Star Domain, but the most important thing was Ao Qing.

"Ao Qing."

Looking at Ao Qing with her head raised and her chest raised below, Yan Lingyun smiled slightly.

"Miss mother."

At this time, Ao Qing was naturally very happy.

He knew that he had made great contributions and that his mistress was his master's wife.

What a character his master is, it is almost impossible to describe in words.

And the mistress is so close to the master, so I just need to lick the mistress and the little master, and then my future will definitely be smooth.

Ao Qing saw this clearly.

"Ao Qing, this time, you have made great contributions. What do you want?"

Looking at Ao Qing, Yan Lingyun smiled faintly.

Hearing this, Ao Qing said seriously: "My mistress was joking. The master has cultivated me, and the little master has taken me in. You are the little master's mother and the master's wife. All this Ao Qing did, It's all right! ”

As soon as these words came out, Wang Zhen, who was standing beside him, was stunned for a moment.

He is worthy of being Senior Ao Qing.

This is a state that I will never reach in my life.

Looking at His Majesty's smile, Wang Zhen immediately began to reflect. It turned out that it was also very important to say good things.

At this time, Yan Lingyun was indeed very happy.

Looking at Ao Qing, Yan Lingyun suddenly understood why Ao Qing's strength improved so quickly.

This dragon really understands how to seize opportunities.

Just like now.

"You have done a good job. When your master comes back, I will praise you very much."

Yan Lingyun smiled.

And this is also the answer Ao Qing wants to hear the most.

Isn’t that just the wind beside the pillow?

The effect must be good.

Ao Qing was excited, but still said without changing his expression: "Thank you for your kindness."

Immediately, Ao Qing and Wang Zhen retreated.

On the way.

"Senior Ao Qing!"

Hearing the shouts behind him, Ao Qing stopped and turned to look.

"Huh? What's wrong?"

Looking at Wang Zhen behind him with a slightly squinted look, Ao Qing asked in a faint voice.

"Uh, Senior Ao Qing, Wang was so presumptuous before. I hope you don't remember the villain's mistakes and don't take them to heart."

Wang Zhen bowed and immediately said what he was thinking.

Ao Qing was not surprised at all when he heard Wang Zhen's words.

From the first time I saw Wang Zhen, Ao Qing saw the disdain deep in Wang Zhen's eyes.

Ao Qing naturally doesn't take this seriously.

In his eyes, there are really no one else who has a real identity except Lu Daosheng and Lu Xue.

Even my own father can't do it.

Of course, there is another Yan Lingyun now.

Similarly, Ao Qing didn't take Wang Zhen seriously at all. In his eyes, he was just an ant who could control it casually.

But Wang Zhen was able to treat him honestly and apologize to him, Ao Qing was not a stingy dragon.

Although he knew that it was all because of his own strength.

"Okay, there's nothing big about it. Do you have anything else? If not, I'm leaving."

Ao Qing responded in a faint voice.

Seeing Ao Qing's casual attitude, Wang Zhen's smile was a little bitter.

Yes, this kind of existence does not care about the views of people of his strength.

"No, no more."

Wang Zhen shook his head.

Standing in place, looking at Ao Qing who turned around and left without looking back, Wang Zhen's expression gradually became firm.

Only strength is the most important.

Not long after, Wang Zhen left the Zhishen Star Region again and led the army to garrison in the Tianlin Star Region.

In another slightly smaller and gorgeous palace.

"My lady, I'm back!"

As soon as he entered the palace, Ao Qing yelled.

Looking at Lu Xue who was sitting in the pavilion and calm, Ao Qing was so excited that tears almost came out.

"My lady,"

"Don't make a fuss!"

Raising her eyebrows slightly, Lu Xue glanced at Ao Qing and curled her lips.

It's as if you haven't seen me for 800 years. Isn't it just a few days away?

Hearing Lu Xue's scolding, Ao Qing quickly lowered his head and carefully came to Lu Xue.

Lu Xue took a deep breath, then took the cup of water handed over by Ao Qing and drank a sip.

"How is it, nothing unexpected happened?"

Ao Qing shook his head, looking quite proud, "Don't worry, young master, I'm here, how can anything unexpected happen?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue rolled her eyes, and then said unhappily: "See what you can do, you didn't eat so many good things in vain."

At this time, Ao Qing suddenly remembered something.

"By the way, young master, Hun Gu Star Domain and Huo Ling Star Domain surrendered."

Hun Gu Star Domain, Huo Ling Star Domain.

Lu Xue also heard a little about these two star domains. It is said that their strength is very strong among many known star domains.

These two star domains are just after Tianlin Star Domain, and are also the next target of the Divine Dynasty.

However, Lu Xue thought it was natural.

"If you can't beat my mother's people, it's right to surrender."

"No, young master, they surrendered to our Huangcheng."

"Ah?"

Huangcheng?

Lu Xue was a little confused.

Isn't Huangcheng very far from here?

"What's going on? Tell me."

When Lu Xue heard about the deserted city, she was a little excited. After all, she had been out for a while. It would be a lie to say that she didn't miss the deserted city.

Seeing Lu Xue's anxious look, Ao Qing hesitated and said, "My lady, it seems that our deserted city has already attacked us. Yunqi is really powerful. I heard that guy even invited a military to help."

After hearing this, Lu Xue was stunned for a long time.

It seems that it's time for me to go back and take a look.

But after thinking about it carefully, it seems that it's good that the deserted city has attacked us. It's just closer to home.
